decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 4 - The brickwork part of the side boundary wall hereby approved shall have a height of no more than 600mm for not less than 2.4m in width to the side of the crossover. The remainder of this part of the wall shall have a metal grille with upright bars spaced not less than 10cm apart and the space between the bars shall not be filled in.
Condition : 5 - The modified access shall not be used before the alteration to the footway crossover as shown on the drawings hereby approved have been carried out.
description: Erection of a new boundary wall and gates.
